protocol.scope: Selected numerical validation points, not a full prior-domain guarantee, an inference benchmark or calibration. Timing fields diagnose execution and are not performance rankings.
protocol.stop_rule: A time or memory limit terminates the condition. Retain completed cases, the last running case and the failure; do not change seeds, configurations or thresholds after seeing results.

finite_difference.parameter_scale: max(abs(theta_j),0.1), in the declared physical parameter units
finite_difference.derivative_relative_error: Also report abs(J_AD-J_FD)/max(abs(J_AD),abs(J_FD),1e-12); do not hide nearly-zero derivatives behind this metric.

protocol.reporting: Save every prediction, Jacobian, both finite-difference step results, warnings, runtime source hashes, environment, actual device, first and warm call latency, host peak RSS and available GPU allocator statistics. NumPy/JAX agreement is a consistency check. The separate analytic Plummer/JAM protocol provides independent equation-level evidence. A successful point does not imply positivity of a global distribution function.
